items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: I worked with uh, Wooden Joe, when Wooden Joe had a real old Wooden Joe's band

ctx.x: When you came back over here, you worked with Billy and the Dee some, didn't you?

Yeah, I worked with Billy and the Dee, I worked with uh, George, George Anderson, I worked with uh, Wooden Joe, when Wooden Joe had a real old Wooden Joe's band with uh, with uh, Johnny Proudos, Buddy Luck, John Smith, uh, Edmund Garman, uh.

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-12-09
items.q: Well tell me about playing with Wooden Joe.

ctx.x: But he couldn't play no more. He was way up, way up by the protection of the levy. And he'd see you sick. He'd have that coat on, that cap, as I must care for you. He loved his music. He was a bass player. John Smith was a pimp. He had a lot of women dressed very good. He was in Ace Blossom, one of the Zulus Club. He was a band-girl. Wood-Jill Trump, sometimes called him. Sometimes he was a friend I named Homer. He lived on the main. Jetson was called the same block as the high court. He was in Jetson. He signed…
Well tell me about playing with Wooden Joe. That's another thing I wanted to ask you about. What? Wood Joe?

Uh, I don't know what they're with Joe. Oh, Dan, he's steady. How clear that Bank was just dead or gone. He was a writer, Wooden Joe. Arthur Holden was a snare drummer today. He was a drummer. Uh, what are you looking for today? What are you looking for today? Uh, any day in the job. Oh, no. Uh, I came on the job. I came on the, because usually all of them hang out. All those things hang up. Uh, A quarter was B and Murray. And already in the beginning of the old trail memory. And right across from there was uh,…

items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: I never did ask him about his father. He don't talk much about it. No, he don't talk about that. Nobody, nobody. No, never said a word about it. I asked him a couple of times.

ctx.x: I didn't think he was George's father. Yeah, yeah.
I never did ask him about his father. He don't talk much about it. No, he don't talk about that. Nobody, nobody. No, never said a word about it. I asked him a couple of times.
And his mother, you know, is named Zeno now. Yeah.
